premise: The sun goes down, each thing in the forest says goodnight in its own way, and the moon keeps watch.
inspiration: The goodnight litany of folk lullabies, which name each thing in turn; turned so that the night itself has friends who keep watch.
lesson: Night is a safe, kind time, watched over by friends.

en-US.title: The Forest Goes to Sleep
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 24s} [softly] The sun is going down behind the hills, and the whole forest turns orange and pink. Time for bed. The {mushroom:enter} mushroom {mushroom:pulse} tucks herself under her cap. {mushroom:face sleeping} Goodnight, mushroom. The tree rocks his branches, slow and low. Goodnight, tree. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} Now the sky is deep blue, and here comes the moon, round and kind. A {firefly:enter} firefly {firefly:fade-in} switches on her little light. {firefly:glow} {firefly:face happy} Goodnight, firefly. {sfx:crickets} Cri-cri, sing the crickets, cri-cri. {sfx:owl-hoot solo} High in the tree, the {owl:enter} owl {owl:fade-in} opens his big round eyes. {owl:face happy} [whispers] Don't worry, he says. The moon and I will keep watch. {all:face sleeping} [yawns] Goodnight, forest. {owl:face happy} Goodnight.

es-ES.title: El bosque se va a dormir
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 24s} [softly] El sol se esconde detrás de las colinas, y todo el bosque se vuelve naranja y rosa. Hora de dormir. La {mushroom:enter} seta {mushroom:pulse} se arropa bajo su sombrero. {mushroom:face sleeping} Buenas noches, seta. El árbol mece sus ramas, despacito, despacito. Buenas noches, árbol. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} Ahora el cielo es azul oscuro, y aquí llega la luna, redonda y buena. Una {firefly:enter} luciérnaga {firefly:fade-in} enciende su lucecita. {firefly:glow} {firefly:face happy} Buenas noches, luciérnaga. {sfx:crickets} Cri-cri, cantan los grillos, cri-cri. {sfx:owl-hoot solo} En lo alto del árbol, el {owl:enter} búho {owl:fade-in} abre sus grandes ojos redondos. {owl:face happy} [whispers] No os preocupéis, dice. La luna y yo vigilamos. {all:face sleeping} [yawns] Buenas noches, bosque. {owl:face happy} Buenas noches.

crickets.prompt: soft summer night crickets chirping gently far away
